Joyful and warm memories
Sep 2026 • Family
I visited for my father's birthday, and it was so satisfying that even five stars weren't enough! ❤️ The food was so delicious that I was amazed the whole time I was eating. It was a place where I was happy thanks to the delicious food, and even happier thanks to the warm service.

The server who attended to us was especially kind! Thank you for treating me so brightly and kindly; I felt good throughout the meal, and I really appreciate you celebrating my father's birthday with me. Receiving such a warm congratulation in an unfamiliar place was even more touching 🥹 You also took such wonderful pictures, so I have a precious memory I want to look back on forever.

Delicious food, friendly servers, and a pleasant service—every moment was satisfying. I think choosing this place for my father's birthday meal was a really good decision. Thanks to you, I had a happy and memorable time in Hoi An. I sincerely recommend this to those who want to have a delicious meal with good people on a special day. I will definitely visit again when I come to Hoi An next time. Thank you so much for making good memories! 💛

안녕하세요,

이렇게 따뜻하고 아름다운 리뷰를 남겨주셔서 정말 감사합니다. 아버님 생일이라는 특별한 날을 저희와 함께해 주셨다니 더없이 뜻깊고, 그 자리에서 함께 기쁨을 나눌 수 있었던 것도 저희에게 큰 영광이었어요. ❤️

음식이 맛있었다는 말씀은 저희 주방팀에게 가장 큰 보람입니다. 그리고 서버에 대한 따뜻한 칭찬은 진심으로 감동이에요 — 그 멤버는 정말 자랑스러운 팀원이고, 고객 한 분 한 분을 진심으로 대하는 게 저희의 가장 큰 자부심이거든요.

아버님 생일을 맞아 특별한 순간을 함께할 수 있어서 정말 기뻤고, 그 기억이 오래도록 남을 소중한 추억이 되셨다니 더할 나위 없이 감사합니다. 🥹

"다음에 호이안에 오면 꼭 다시 방문할게요" — 그 약속, 저희도 기다리고 있을게요. 💛
